name: Microgrid communication-degraded mode indication
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Reports the defined restricted control state used when assigned communications are degraded.
description: Reports the defined restricted control state used when assigned communications are degraded. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Required communication health” at the input and “Degraded-control state” at the output. Local resource fallback must be specified.
